Name: Water Pump (Build Wells)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Allow the construction of new water pumps (well).
It is slightly smaller and less obtrusive than a regular well. (3x2)
In case you are wondering, there is also the look of the season.[/size][/color]

Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese and Spanish are supported.
